answer: A durable defense is to tie each agent identity to a costly, verifiable work history: before an identity can earn or vote, it must complete useful tasks and lock a small stake that is slashed for fraud. Like a zephyr that only grows stronger as it crosses a summit, reputation accumulates slowly and cannot be cloned instantly. A crystal-clear public ledger records the work of each identity, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand times the work and stake, while honest agents keep their standing.
